messages.subject: R DataTable Package-After Pressing "Print" or "PDF" the table is printed in black/white (Colorless)
parts:
I am using R DataTable package. 

This is part of my code:

DT::datatable(RD,  extensions = 'Buttons', 
                      options = list(pageLength = nrow(RD),deferRender = TRUE, scrollY = 770,scrollX = 1400, scroller = TRUE,fixedHeader = FALSE,dom = 'Bfrtip',
                                     buttons = c('copy', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print', 'colvis'),columnDefs = list(list(targets = (1:ncol(RD)), visible = T))


I am able to make 5 buttons and they are all functional.
However, when clicking "PDF" or "Print," produce a colorless version of my table (black/white).
Can you please help me to resolve this issue.

Thanks.
